filter_trace_by_iteration: filter a PyTorch trace DataFrame to keep only events from specific training iterations using IterationFilter
filter_trace_by_time_range: filter a PyTorch trace DataFrame to keep only events within a start and end timestamp using TimeRangeFilter
filter_gpu_kernels: filter a PyTorch trace DataFrame to keep only GPU kernel events using GPUKernelFilter
filter_cpu_operators: filter a PyTorch trace DataFrame to keep only CPU operator events using CPUOperatorFilter
combine_trace_filters: combine multiple trace filters with CompositeFilter to apply iteration and time range constraints together
